Hello, Noiro sensei, I really adore the facial expressions you draw—they are incredibly cute, beautiful, and captivating. Can you draw my OCs? 💖Below are the settings for both characters.

◆ Relationship: From enemies to friends. ⚪ was almost killed by 🔴 in the past.

VAL-K-ASH❤
◆ Gender: Male
◆ Height: 185+ cm
◆ A robot created by humans to "resolve the robot rebellion." He needs to consume components from other robots to maintain stable functionality (analogous to a cannibal in human terms).
◆ He has a very gentle and cheerful personality and gets along well with Phosto. However, he lacks moral restraint when it comes to killing, which sometimes frightens Phosto (especially when the whites of his eyes turn red, making him appear intimidating).
◆ His wings are usually retracted.
◆ The ends of his scarf resemble a tail—they lift up when he’s in a good mood and droop down when he’s upset.
◆ The patterns in his eyes change according to his emotions.

Phosto🤍
◆ Gender: Male
◆ Height: 165 cm (short hair) – 173+ cm (long hair)
◆ A second-generation robot created independently by the robot rebels opposing humanity. He managed to persuade ASH to stop working for humans (after nearly being killed by him), and the two now have a good relationship. He possesses supernatural abilities.
◆ Tsundere, chuunibyou, exceptionally talented, and highly confident in his abilities. Usually appears listless but instantly becomes energetic when something interests him.
◆ Poor at interpersonal relationships and secretly fears being abandoned by friends. Likes gothic and demon-related themes.
◆ Has no issue with killing and will participate when necessary, though he is occasionally startled by ASH’s behavior.
◆ The patterns in his eyes change according to his emotions.

Please feel free to express yourself! If the amount I provided is insufficient, I apologize for any inconvenience. If possible, I would appreciate it if you could refund the payment. Thank you!💖

Intended use: Personal appreciation, non-profit printing.
